description: This PHP class 'GenericDateDisplayField' extends 'CombinedDisplayField' and is part of the OrangeHRM system. It manages the display fields for various date-related attributes (such as birthday, join date, termination date) in reports, including setting entity aliases and field names based on a predefined mapping.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayField
classes.description: Represents a display field for date attributes within reports, capable of mapping field aliases to entity fields and providing related metadata.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field based on the provided DisplayField's alias, using a predefined mapping.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Sets the entity alias used for the display field.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the field name for the display field.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used by this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used in this display field.
